besluite.rede: 'Gister kon dit reën' is natural Afrikaans for an illustrative possibility parallel to 'vandag kan'; 'Dit kan gister gereën het' turns it into doubt about whether it rained, which moves the meaning and alters the hedge.
'Een plek se weer' reads acceptably and stresses one and the same place over many years, matching the 'Een dag' contrast in the next block, so the swap to 'n is a lateral move.
